about: Written by the docs media tools (node scripts/docs-media.mjs and the shot scripts) after each render: the fingerprint of every docs picture and clip, so node scripts/docs-media.mjs --stale rebuilds what changed. On a merge conflict, take either side, then run node scripts/docs-media.mjs --adopt <effect ids the other side re-rendered> (plain --adopt records only assets without a fingerprint and leaves those stale).
